topology.a_c_and_chain_host: node A (tosmr-a, 10.231.78.10) and the stranger C (tosmr-c, 10.231.78.12) in network namespaces on bridge tosmr-br0 (host end 10.231.78.1); each routes through the host, which forwards and masquerades only TCP to the two relays' TLS port (tagged iptables rules, removed at the end); the three validators listen on 127.0.0.1, JSON-RPC ports [49880, 49881, 49882]
topology.b_host: node B on a separate VPS over SSH, every file inside one scratch directory removed at the end; its processes run as root there (the scratch directory is 0700); the chain's JSON-RPC reaches it only through an SSH reverse tunnel bound to its 127.0.0.1
topology.relays: two installed tos-service-packet-relay units on two further VPS, TLS under the pinned test CA
topology.firewall: A and C: outgoing only to the relays' TLS port and the forwarder ports, no incoming connection, and a host bridge table drops every frame between them; B: its host firewall is untouched except for the cut-off rules in an nft table of the run's own
topology.files: B's node files are at the same absolute path on both hosts: staged to B once and mirrored back to this host read-only (rsync over SSH), so the harness reads B's journals, cards and logs
topology.thermal_guard: pauses and resumes this host's run and validators; B and the relays are not paused

not_openfox: creating, funding and activating the three wallets with tosctl and the zerostate faucet

each node's Messaging Endpoint identity: Endpoint and owner keys, the delegation and descriptor policy (scripts/messenger-relay-e2e-tool identity), and its commitment on chain (tosctl agent native-registry action --kind delegate, then tosctl wallet send)
the test Endpoint signer (scripts/messenger-relay-e2e-tool signer): the Messenger ships only the signer client
the Agent revocation at the end (tosctl agent native-registry action --kind revoke-agent)
the network namespaces, firewall rules, forwarders and the relay daemons
the Messenger runtime calls (scripts/messenger-relay-e2e-tool call): this script is the Agent runtime of both nodes
the adversarial envelopes (scripts/messenger-relay-e2e-tool craft) and this script's relay reads, deposits and chain reads
staging B's node files to its host and mirroring them back (rsync over SSH), the supervisor that runs B's processes there, and the SSH reverse tunnel for B's chain RPC
the cut-off rules on B's host (an nft table of the run's own) and relay 1's systemctl stop/start
the harness's tosctl actions for B (the delegation and the Agent revocation) run on the A/C host with a copy of B's vault: B's wallet was created there before it was staged
relay_retention: the relays run with -ttl 1h (test environment; see relay_units.*.arguments); an unacknowledged copy is re-deposited by its sender every 600 s (client setting)
outage: relay 1's installed unit is stopped (systemctl stop) for the whole conversation and started again
crash_window_a: phase 1 opened A's crash window by pausing both relay daemons; here A's packets to both relays are silently dropped in A's namespace instead (the relays stay up), so A's deposit is in flight while its daemon is killed and completes once the drop is lifted

daemon_configuration.note: the re-deposit interval is the shortest the daemon accepts (a test MAY set 10 min to 20 h, spec 4); the descriptor lifetime is short so the evidence pull and the descriptor-expired retry run live

contact_exchange.not_handed: a -> b: B learns A in band

signing_cost.note: sign_seconds is the tosctl sign time of one chat packet, measured by the harness's craft helper signing as a node's own controller through its tosctl custody (the controller and context OpenFox's carrier uses). It is sign only; the deposit is a separate TLS round trip.

steps.name: [M-R1 5] descriptor expiry: B receives the retained copy whose frame evidence expired and answers a signed `rejected` ack with descriptor-expired (A is admitted); the copy does not reach B's runtime

[M-R1 5] mutual staleness: one kind-4 request (A) and one response (B), each carrying its sender's card and fresh evidence, make both views fresh; A retries the copy only with newer evidence and it is delivered and applied once

[M-R1 5] no kind-4 request is sent to a peer without a pending copy, none is repeated before the re-deposit schedule, and the descriptors each node published during the run sent none
the runtime of a queued 'before-revocation'

not OpenFox: B's Agent is revoked on chain (tosctl agent native-registry action --kind revoke-agent), which withdraws its Endpoint delegation
[M-R1 5] after B's Endpoint delegation is withdrawn on chain, A's runtime answers a new send and refuses it with a revocation code (CheckPeer reads finalized state); no copy is sealed or carried
